title: Havenline equipment and resource-output source coverage
purpose: Source map for a bounded 20-sheet concept-art expansion; not a production recipe registry or runtime approval.

status_legend.confirmed_runtime: Behavior is visible in the inspected runtime source at the named commit.
status_legend.locked_reference_design: Observed reference-video chain is required design; implementation is not implied.
status_legend.direct_visual_reference: Equipment or output shape is directly visible in supplied art; recipes are not implied.
status_legend.planned_or_depicted_equipment: Equipment exists as a label/depiction; conversion outputs remain unspecified.
status_legend.explicit_resource_nouns_only: Resource name is explicit, but its recipe and station association are not.
status_legend.request_concept_and_ambiguous_reference: A requested concept and a separately ambiguous source depiction; neither establishes a conversion recipe.
status_legend.art_proposal: New visual planning proposal, not an implemented drop/recipe claim.
status_legend.unspecified: No exact output/recipe evidence was found within the inspected scope.

inspection_scope.unseen_source_boundary: No 18611/18613 repository binding found in inspected documents; no unseen higher-tier production chain is inferred.
inspection_scope.construction_boundary: world_transform_recipes.json is construction state/debit evidence, not material conversion evidence.

sources.evidence: KINDS and inventory/stored dictionaries contain wood, stone, metal and fuel. Deposit transfers raw resources to stored; furnace level/warmth upgrades do not manufacture a new inventory item.
Gather/deposit/repair transitions account for raw resource units. No cooking, drying, milling, smelting or tanning recipe table was found.
Customer resource orders use the same raw KINDS. Service consumes resource units for credits; it is not proof of a food conversion.
Wood and stone resolved; metal is frozen ore and fuel is frozen salvage. Fish T16 and wheat T19 require freeze and have production_ready=false.

Reference A fish acquisition -> staffed processor -> cooked output -> counter, plus wheat/mechanized harvest -> blue/orange processing -> bread-like output. Explicitly forbids inventing an unshown exact recipe.

Visual kit lists fishing_rack, intake_machine, conveyor_straight, cooker_processor, processing_counter, service_counter, hearth_vessel and resource props. runtime_logic_included=false and visual_approval_claimed=false.
T05 supplies visual/attachment foundations; recipes, processing behavior, production rates, economy and inventory are outside its scope.
prebuild_fixtures=true. Seed/foundation/reinforced debit wood, stone and metal for construction; these are not material processing recipes.

Enlarged resource row reads WOOD, STONE, IRON ORE, COAL, MEAT, HIDE, HERBS, FUR, CRYSTAL and PLANK. A can has an ambiguous/garbled 'OIEL' label, likely intended oil/fuel. STEEL is not explicitly named. Resource labels do not establish production routes, species drops or recipe parameters.

The original user request explicitly included steel among the requested material renders. The prior 13-sheet set preserves a reviewed steel concept; this is not an atlas label or proof of a smelting recipe.
